title.zh: 在大马尼拉 Valenzuela 市将 Lawang Bato 附属校从市镇中学分离并设立为国立中学，为其提供经费
title.en: An Act Creating the Lawang Bato National High School in Valenzuela, Metro Manila, By Separating the Lawang Bato Annex From the Valenzuela Municipal High School, and Providing Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Creating the Lawang Bato National High School in Valenzuela, Metro Manila, By Separating the Lawang Bato Annex From the Valenzuela Municipal High School, and Providing Funds Therefor

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1998/ra_8723_1998.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Lawang Bato Annex of Valenzuela Municipal High School located in Barangay Lawang Bato, Municipality of Valenzuela, Metro Manila, is hereby separated from the said Valenzuela Municipal High School, and thereafter created as an. independent educational institution to be known as the Lawang Bato National High School.
All properties and assets presently pertaining or belonging to the Valenzuela Municipal High School-Lawang Bato Annex are hereby transferred to the newly created Lawang Bato National High School.

The funding requirements for the operation of the Lawang Bato National High School shall be charged to the appropriations for the current fiscal year of the Valenzuela Municipal High School-Lawang Bato Annex. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for the implementation of this Act is hereby, authorized to be appropriated in the annual General Appropriations Act.

The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall make the necessary directive to effect the separation of Lawang Bato Annex from the Valenzuela Municipal High School, as well as to bring about the smooth operation of the Lawang Bato National High School under this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
